summary: Read one encoded piece of text. When a positive integer k sits immediately before a matching pair of brackets, the fragment inside is copied k times in place. Brackets may be nested, and inner fragments expand first. The text is always valid: there is no stray whitespace, brackets match, letters contain no digits, and digits serve only as copy counts. A count glued to a letter without brackets never appears. Write the fully expanded text.
notes: Compare after trimming trailing newlines. The input is one token of text without spaces.
